insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Varus is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Varus in 26/62 games (42%): 9 picks (4-5) and 17 bans.

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: G1 first pick: Gwen
insights.text: With first pick in Game 1 they took Gwen 5/10 times (50%). Overall 6-3 on it. Ban it or be ready to answer it in G1.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Rell? They go Rakan
insights.text: Rell is a G1 favorite (8/25 G1s, played by Trymbi). In the 23 later games where it was burned or banned, Trymbi went to Rakan (4/23) and Neeko (4/23).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they go about as deep as the league
insights.text: In 19 G3+ games, 27/95 picks (28%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 50 champs in G1s, 58 in G3+.
